import re

# Test the concept of what we need

# 1. IPv4 pattern - no leading zeros
# Each octet: 0-9, 10-99, 100-199, 200-249, 250-255
ipv4_octet = r'(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])'
ipv4_pattern = rf'(?:\b{ipv4_octet}\.{ipv4_octet}\.{ipv4_octet}\.{ipv4_octet}\b)'

# 2. Date pattern - YYYY-MM-DD
# Year: 4 digits
# Month: 01-12
# Day: 01-31 (but Feb can have 29)
date_pattern = r'(?:\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]))'

# Test with sample lines
test_lines = [
    "192.168.1.1 - - [2024-01-15] Error occurred",
    "192.168.1.1 - - [2024-01-15] Error 2024-02-29 occurred",
    "no ip here 2024-01-15 should not match",

    "user 1134-12-1234 should not match 192.168.1.1",
    "192.168.1.1 2024-13-01 invalid month",
    "192.168.1.1 2024-02-30 invalid day",
]

print("Testing IPv4 pattern:")
for line in test_lines:
    if re.search(ipv4_pattern, line):
        print(f"✓ Found IPv4 in: {line}")
    else:
        print(f"✗ No IPv4 in: {line}")

print("\n\nTesting Date pattern:")
for line in test_lines:
    matches = re.findall(date_pattern, line)
    if matches:
        print(f"Dates in '{line}': {matches}")
    else:
        print(f"No dates in '{line}'")

EOF
